```http
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/example.org/relationships
    ?relationship_type=subdomains
    &limit=10
    &continuation_cursor=abc
```

Include your API key in the `x-apikey` header:

```
x-apikey: my_api
```

The response will contain a list of related object descriptors; you can then extract just the `id` fields (and any `context_attributes` you need) from each item.

If you need help formatting the request or parsing the response, let me know!
